intro: Crafted for every kind of gathering, Dinex blends timeless marble finish, smart extension, and stable design—ideal for everyday meals or celebratory feasts.

features.title: Elegance that endures
features.text: The glossy marble-pattern MDF top offers timeless elegance with high scratch resistance—tested up to 8H pencil hardness for daily durability.

features.title: Smooth, effortless extension
features.text: The auto-opening central panel glides out seamlessly, transforming the table from a 6-seater to 8-seater without a hitch—ideal for flexible hosting.

features.title: Sculpted for comfort
features.text: The unique capsule-shaped top with soft, rounded edges brings a warm and welcoming vibe to every meal, while enhancing user safety.

features.title: Stable from the core
features.text: Inclined, powder-coated MS legs and a custom underframe provide strong support in both compact and extended modes for worry-free dining.

features.title: Legroom that adapts
features.text: Designed to optimize leg space for 6 users daily and extend comfortably for 8—no crowding, just seamless seating for everyone.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
